gate_type: D-DAY TRACK B — DDAY-B2 CORRECTION (SEMANTIC ISOLATION + HARNESS GATE REPAIR)
objective: Correction of the two SA-verified DDAY-B2 blockers, without broadening B2. (a) Remove legacy 'ASSY' lifecycle semantics from Bottled Water outward runtime facts while preserving legacy indexed-line behaviour: generic introduce_unit() must no longer assign WipLifecycle.IN_ASSY, and the generic route must publish a domain-neutral status at entry, in progress, at completion and at reject. (b) Repair the confirmed P21/P22 harness inconsistency in .ai-harness/scripts/run_task_gate.py so the task gate can validate its own provisional report, after which the full DDAY-B2 task gate must run through P24 for the exact head.

No modification of any file outside the allowlist (no other production, config, protocol or deployment file)

No new engine, no fork, no parallel controller
